sources.title: PuzzleComm/TDN · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TDN is the DINOv3-only text-aligned model released with the TDDN project. It is the controlled single-encoder counterpart to TDDN: it starts from a frozen DINOv3 ViT-H/16+ visual representation and aligns it with a frozen RoBERTa-large text encoder using the same lightweight alignment pipeline as TDDN.

sources.snippet: Structured visual reasoning, such as image puzzles, demands fine-grained visual perception, an ability current Vision Language Models (VLMs) lack. VLMs built on CLIP-based ViT backbones trade fine-grained detail for high-level semantics, and we show this loss propagates downstream. sources.title: TDDN: Text-aligned Diffused DINO Network for Puzzle Understanding
sources.snippet: We introduce TDDN, a text-aligned visual representation model built in two stages: (1) DIFFUSEDINO, which fuses the perceptual precision of CleanDIFT with the semantic consistency of DINOv3, and (2) lightweight vision-language alignment using ~ 590k image-text pairs.
